verdict.rationale: Plaid is an API-first product. Its docs cover the Plaid API across Auth, Balance, Identity, Transactions and Payments, plus webhooks for async events and a free Sandbox. The Sandbox supports programmatic Item creation via /sandbox/public_token/create, and the official plaid-node SDK shows typed API calls like transactionsSync. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed public paths (all returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API end-to-end.
